CustomGas documentation

A thinny wrapper for the CoolProp low-level interface.

Example:

def main():
    gas_temperature = 300
    gas_pressure = 10e5
    gas_mix = {'CarbonDioxide': 0.33, 'Hydrogen': 0.33, 'Methane': 0.34}
    gas = Gas.new(gas_mix=gas_mix, percent=Percent.MASS)
    gas.update_state(gas_pressure, gas_temperature)
    gas.add_water_to_gas_mix(1)
    gas.density()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
class customgas.Gas(backend, name)

Wrapper for the CoolProp-Lowlevel-API to get a more readable and cleaner source code. The free backend ‘HEOS’ is used. Use new() function to create a Gas instance.

__init__(backend, name)

See Gas.new() for creating a Gas instance.

classmethod new(**kwargs)

Function to create a new Gas instance. The name argument specifies the gas name. To create a gas mixture, use the gas_mix and percent keyword arguments. Example: Gas.new(gas_mix={‘CarbonDioxide’: 0.5, ‘Hydrogen’: 0.5}, percent=Percent.MASS). percent is a constant of the Percent() and indicates whether it is a mass-percent or a volume-percent values.

Parameters:

kwargs – name: str | gas_mix: dict percent: int

Returns:

Gas()

add_water_to_gas_mix(humidity)

Recalculation of the gas mix to account for the water content in the gas. This is an approximation, as the absorption of water in dry air serves as the basis for the calculation.

Parameters:

humidity (int | float) – In fraction

Returns:

Gas with Percent.VOLUME and the calculates parts of water.
